name: Cultivating Courage: Overcoming Fear in Career and Life
description: Drawing on psychology, neuroscience, and storytelling, the author outlines practical tools for confronting fear and taking bold action. Exercises include exposure drills, confidence visualizations, and narrative reframing. Readers are guided to build a personal courage roadmap.
shortDescription: A practical guide to confronting fear and building confidence.
